# POST /api/owners — Complete Ordered Flow

## Route resolution
The endpoint is handled by `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner(...)`. The V2 controller only adds `GET /api/owners` paging (`listOwnersPage`) and has no create. Path assembly: class-level `@RequestMapping("/api")` (`OwnerRestControllerV1.java:69`) + the inherited method mapping `POST /owners` from the generated interface (`OwnersApi.java:52,79-84`) = `POST /api/owners`.

Files involved:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/api/OwnersApi.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/dto/OwnerFieldsDto.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`, `Person.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/target/generated-sources/annotations/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapperImpl.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicServiceImpl.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/jpa/JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/advice/ExceptionControllerAdvice.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/security/BasicAuthenticationConfig.java`, `Roles.java`

---

## Phase 0 — Security filters (before the controller; only when `petclinic.security.enable=true`)
Config `BasicAuthenticationConfig.java:18-43`: CSRF disabled, HTTP Basic, `anyRequest().authenticated()` via a JDBC user store. `@EnableMethodSecurity(prePostEnabled = true)` (line 19) activates the method-level `@PreAuthorize`. If security is disabled, `DisableSecurityConfig` applies instead. (When the property is unset/false, this chain is absent.)

## Phase 1 — Bean Validation on the request body (before the method body runs)
The generated interface declares the parameter `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto` (`OwnersApi.java:86`) and the interface is `@Validated` (`OwnersApi.java:44`). Spring validates `OwnerFieldsDto` before the controller body executes. Constraints (`OwnerFieldsDto.java`):
- `firstName` — `@NotNull @Pattern(^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}$) @Size(min=1,max=30)` (lines 121)
- `lastName` — `@NotNull @Pattern(^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}\.?$) @Size(min=1,max=30)` (line 142)
- `city` — `@NotNull @Size(min=1,max=80)` (line 247)
- `telephone` — `@NotNull @Size(min=1,max=20)` (line 268)
- `email` — `@Size(min=1,max=255) @Email` (line 289)
- `address` / `addressLine1` / `addressLine2` — `@Size(min=1,max=255)` (lines 184, 205, 226)
- `postcode` — `@Pattern(^[0-9]{4}$)` (line 352)
- `registrationDate`, `birthDate` — `@Valid` (LocalDate) (lines 310, 331)
- `title` — enum `MR/MRS/MS/DR`; `sharesHousehold` — Boolean, default `false` (line 96)

On failure → `MethodArgumentNotValidException` → `ExceptionControllerAdvice.handleMethodArgumentNotValidException` → **400** with per-field `schemaValidationErrors`/`errors` (advice lines 133-169). Note: the `Owner` entity's own Bean Validation annotations (`Person` `@NotEmpty firstName/lastName`; `Owner` `@NotEmpty address/city/telephone`, `@Pattern` E.164 telephone `Owner.java:58`, `@Email`) are **not** re-validated here — the entity is never `@Valid`-checked on the save path (no `@Valid` on `saveOwner`, no validating persistence config observed).

## Phase 2 — Authorization
`@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")` on `addOwner` (`OwnerRestControllerV1.java:136`) requires `ROLE_OWNER_ADMIN` (`Roles.java:8`). Denied → `AccessDeniedException`, re-thrown by the advice (lines 84-87) so Spring Security renders **403/401** (not 500).

## Phase 3 — Controller body `addOwner` (`OwnerRestControllerV1.java:138-243`), in exact order

Important boundary note: **the controller method is NOT `@Transactional`.** Every `clinicService` call below runs in its own separate transaction (each service method is annotated `@Transactional`/`@Transactional(readOnly=true)` in `ClinicServiceImpl`). So the many `findAllOwners()` reads and the final `saveOwner()` are independent transactions; there is no single atomic boundary around the create.

1. **Idempotency lookup** (lines 141-152): read `Idempotency-Key` header via `currentIdempotencyKey()` (lines 353-360). If seen before in the in-memory `ConcurrentHashMap idempotentCreates` (line 86) and the referenced owner still exists (`clinicService.findOwnerById` → tx), map to DTO, set `bulkSignupWarning`, and **return 200 OK early** (no new owner).
2. **Address selection/normalization** (lines 157-165): `structured = addressLine1 non-blank`. `normalizeAddress` (lines 445-469) trims, collapses whitespace, upper-cases, expands `ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`. Composed `address` = line1 (+ " " + line2 if present) when structured, else normalized flat `address`.
3. **Required-field presence check** (lines 166-184): collects missing among `firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone`; if any → `MissingOwnerFieldsException` → **400** (advice 335-346, `errors` lists fields).
4. **Telephone normalization** (line 185) via `normalizeTelephone` (lines 548-582): strips spaces/dashes/brackets; keeps `+`/country code or assumes `+61` (drops one leading `0`); enforces 8–15 digits, `+61`→9 national digits, `+1`→10. Invalid → `InvalidTelephoneException` → **400** (advice 180-191, `errors:["telephone"]`).
5. `sharesHousehold` boolean resolved (line 186).
6. **Map DTO → entity** (line 188) `ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto)` (`OwnerMapperImpl.java:110-134`): copies firstName, lastName, title(name()), address, addressLine1/2, city, telephone, **email (setter lower-cases it — `Owner.setEmail` lines 166-168)**, registrationDate, birthDate, postcode. `id` and `pets` ignored (`OwnerMapper.java:31-32`).
7. **Override address fields** (lines 189-191): sets composed `address`, and `addressLine1/2` (null unless structured).
8. Set normalized `telephone` (line 192).
9. **Email-domain check** (line 193) `validateEmailDomain` (lines 379-391): rejects blocklisted disposable domains (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`) → `DisposableEmailDomainException` → **400** (advice 224-235, `errors:["email"]`).
10. **Postcode range check** (line 194) `validatePostcode(postcode, region)` (lines 413-431): when present, must fall in the region range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099; unknown region = any). Out of range → `InvalidPostcodeException` → **400** (advice 202-213, `errors:["postcode"]`).
11. **Compute householdId** (line 198) `householdIdFor(lastName, postcode)` (lines 799-813): SHA-256 of `normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode`, first 12 hex upper-cased.
12. **Household-duplicate block** (lines 202-204): if `!sharesHousehold` and `isHouseholdInUse` (lines 778-787, does `findAllOwners()` → tx; ignores soft-deleted) → `DuplicateIdentityException` → **409** (advice 270-281, `errors:["identityKey"]`).
13. **Identity-key duplicate block** (lines 207-209): `isIdentityKeyInUse(owner.getIdentityKey())` (lines 593-598, `findAllOwners()` → tx, skips deleted). Identity key = `telephone|email|householdId` (`Owner.getIdentityKey` 466-472). Match → `DuplicateIdentityException` → **409**.
14. **City-capacity check** (lines 210-212): `isCityAtCapacity` (lines 680-686, `findAllOwners()` → tx) ≥ 50 owners in that (normalized) city → `CityAtCapacityException` → **409** (advice 292-303, `errors:["city"]`).
15. **Future-date check** (lines 213-215): if supplied `registrationDate` is after `LocalDate.now()` → `FutureRegistrationDateException` → **400** (advice 246-257, `errors:["registrationDate"]`).
16. **Business-day roll** (lines 216-218): effective date = supplied or today; `toBusinessDay` (lines 726-731) rolls forward past weekends and fixed 2026 public holidays (lines 708-711).
17. **Daily-limit check** (lines 219-221): `isDailyRegistrationLimitReached(registrationDate)` (lines 739-744, `findAllOwners()` → tx) ≥ 100 for that date → `DailyRegistrationLimitException` → **429** (advice 314-324).
18. **Set derived fields on the entity** (lines 222-230):
    - `registrationDate` = rolled business day (222).
    - `customerCode` = `deduplicateCustomerCode(customerCodeFor(owner))` (223): `customerCodeFor` (482-484) = `region + "-" + SHA256(telephone+lastName)[0:8]`; `deduplicateCustomerCode` (495-508) does another `findAllOwners()` → tx and appends `-n` (n≥2) on collision.
    - `namesakeCount` (224) `namesakeCount(firstName,lastName)` (636-643, `findAllOwners()` → tx) = count of existing same-name owners.
    - `householdSize` (225) `householdSizeAfterCreate(householdId)` (656-664, `findAllOwners()` → tx) = existing members + 1.
    - `possibleDuplicate` / `possibleDuplicateOf` (228-230): if not `sharesHousehold`, `possibleDuplicateOf(owner)` (610-624, `findAllOwners()` → tx) = lowest-id existing owner with same normalized lastName + same postcode but different telephone; sets the boolean/id accordingly.
19. **Persist** (line 231) `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)`:
    - `ClinicServiceImpl.saveOwner` (`ClinicServiceImpl.java:232-237`) is `@Transactional` → opens the write transaction.
    - `JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.save` (`JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.java:92-100`): `id == null` → `em.persist(owner)` (insert), else `em.merge`. `@OneToMany(cascade=ALL) pets` (`Owner.java:95`) would cascade, but a create has no pets. **No `@PrePersist`/lifecycle callbacks exist anywhere** (grep found none). The `Owner` entity's own `@NotEmpty/@Pattern/@Email` constraints (Owner.java:43-63, Person.java:32-37) are not enforced at persist time in this configuration.
20. **Record idempotency key** (lines 232-234): if a key was supplied, store `key → owner.getId()` in the in-memory map.
21. **Audit logging** (lines 235-237): `AUDIT.info(...)` on the dedicated `"AUDIT"` SLF4J logger (line 72) — logs id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel, membershipNumber.
22. **Map entity → response DTO** (line 238) `ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner)` (`OwnerMapperImpl.java:24-72`): copies stored fields and computes derived read-only values — `selfLink`, `displayName`, `initials`, `contactPreference` (EMAIL if email present else PHONE), `ageBand`, plus entity-computed `salutation`, `telephoneDisplay`, `checkDigit` (Luhn), `fiscalYear`, `membershipNumber`, `membershipPoints`, `membershipLevel`, `locality`, `timezone`, `identityKey` (Owner.java transient getters).
23. **Set `bulkSignupWarning`** (line 239) `isBulkSignupWarning()` (761-767, `findAllOwners()` → tx): true if > 80 owners already registered today.
24. **Location header** (lines 240-241): `/api/owners/{id}`.
25. **Return** (line 242): **201 Created** with the DTO body and Location header.

## No side-effects present
No password encoding on this path (BCrypt bean exists only for auth users), no email/notification sending, no event publishing (`ApplicationEventPublisher` not used), no caching annotations on this path. The only "notification-like" action is the `AUDIT` log line. Uniqueness is enforced purely in-application via repeated `findAllOwners()` scans (not DB constraints), and each such scan plus the final save is its own transaction.

## Error-to-status summary (via `ExceptionControllerAdvice`)
`MethodArgumentNotValid` → 400; `MissingOwnerFields` → 400; `InvalidTelephone` → 400 (telephone); `InvalidPostcode` → 400 (postcode); `DisposableEmailDomain` → 400 (email); `FutureRegistrationDate` → 400 (registrationDate); `DuplicateIdentity` → 409 (identityKey); `CityAtCapacity` → 409 (city); `DailyRegistrationLimit` → 429; `AccessDenied` → re-thrown (403/401); `DataIntegrityViolation` → 404; any other `Exception` → 500.
